color_reference: clear_day sky and haze hues, and the terrain colour ramp in the shaders, are matched to Perseverance Mastcam-Z colour frames (sols 1211-1217, Bright Angel / Cheyava Falls), kept in ..\ref\perseverance_sol1217\.
